prompt: Policies should explicitly address disadvantage experienced by Asian people.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.

exact_response: Yes—where Asian people experience disadvantage, policies should explicitly address it. That means identifying the specific barriers, using data that distinguishes between Asian communities, and setting measurable actions to reduce inequities without assuming everyone has the same experience.
